title: Clearance games at BAE, 2015-2018

tellings.quote: the problem is is when I was at BAE between 2015 and 2018 they were playing this game.

plain: While working at BAE Systems, a large defence contractor, between 2015 and 2018, Dylan Borland says the people around him were "playing this game" with access to secret information. Borland, a former intelligence worker who has come forward as a whistleblower on the UFO subject, tells Michels this from his own experience, but he leaves the details of the game vague. As he tells it, the point is that access to what he needed was being manipulated.
